l_bruno: Bruno came to us the hard way: someone left him and his brother at our place and drove off. Even so, he has not lost his trust in people. He is a young, very good-natured and affectionate boy who is ready for a fresh start with a family.
l_ayda: Ayda is pure joy: a happy, playful boy and an absolute sweetheart. We rescued him from the Finike shelter and he has been handing out affection ever since. He loves to play and will happily look for everyone’s attention at home.
l_maya: Maya is a beautiful girl we rescued from a shelter. She is 2 years old, spayed and very easy-going. She is wonderful with children, so she could be the perfect companion for a family.
l_charlie: Charlie is another very good-natured boy we rescued from the Finike shelter. He was born on 1 February 2023, is neutered and is looking for a family to share walks and the sofa with.
l_suzi: Suzi (her vet card name is Saçaklı) was born in 2022. She is an easy-going, very sweet girl you can take on long leash walks. She is spayed and ready for her home.
l_thor: Thor is 3 years old and weighs 8 kg. He is a shy boy with a lovely temperament: he needs a little time to feel confident, and then he is a calm and loyal companion. He is neutered.
l_zoren: Zoren was born on 1 January 2020. He has a beautiful nature and adores people: he is always looking for a cuddle. He is neutered and dreams of a home that gives him back all the love he gives.

m1: We connect dogs living in difficult conditions in Türkiye with families who can offer them a safe and loving home.
m2: Every adoption is carried out responsibly and transparently, with the animal’s health, safety and well-being as our top priority.
m3: For international adoptions, we carefully complete all required health checks, vaccinations and legal documents, and we plan every step of the journey so that each animal reaches their new life safely and with as little stress as possible.
m4: Our goal is not simply to complete an adoption, but to build a long-lasting, happy and healthy bond between animals and the families who welcome them into their lives.
w4b: We plan the flight in advance so they arrive in Barcelona safely and with as little stress as possible.
a2: Yes. Before travelling, every dog has a microchip, vaccinations (including rabies), an antibody titration test and a passport, and is neutered.
a3: We work with families in and around Barcelona. We share all the details of the arrival when we plan the flight.
a4: It depends mainly on the rabies test: EU rules require a 3-month wait from the blood sample before the dog can enter the EU. If the dog already has the test done, the process is quicker.

hs_bambi: From a shelter in Türkiye to their family’s sofa. Bambi has discovered that soft blankets and long naps are the best thing ever, and never leaves their side.
hs_princesa: Princesa lives up to the name: elegance, curiosity and an eye on everything going on. Today every corner of a new life is there to explore, with the calm of finally having a home.
hs_rex: Rex hasn’t stopped smiling since arriving home. Play, affection and joy: every day with the family is a little celebration.
hs_vega: From the shelter to the parks of Barcelona. Vega loves walks in the sun and every new adventure in the city with the family.
hs_mini: Small in size, huge at heart. Mini now has a jumper for the winter, a spot on the sofa and a family forever.
hs_arthur: Arthur left the uncertainty of the shelter behind and now rests happily next to a cosy bed. One look at that smile says it all.
